items.text: a notification center keeps rate limits, updates, mentions and other tele notices in one list, also in the chats menu
telegram's waits for sending, reacting, joining or searching get a countdown and go to the center
group messages that mention you or reply to you are kept in the center, muted chats too
items.where: settings → tele → notifications → log mentions and replies

items.text: ids and values copied by tele and tele's toasts are kept in the center
notices from the tele server show up in the center
items.where: settings → tele → server → notifications from the server

items.text: a notification when someone from your list comes online
items.where: settings → tele → notifications → notify when people come online

items.text: release builds get push notifications through google play services
a local password or fingerprint before stars are spent, gifts leave your account or bots are paid
hidden gifts are dimmed, and several gifts can be selected to show, hide, pin, transfer, sell or convert at once
items.where: settings → tele → profiles and ids → select several gifts

items.text: search a profile's gifts by name, model, backdrop and symbol
items.where: settings → tele → profiles and ids → search gifts

items.text: send several gifts at once
items.where: settings → tele → profiles and ids → send several gifts at once

items.text: copy a gift collection's link, and failed collections load again
items.where: settings → tele → profiles and ids → copy gift collection link

items.text: search, filter and export star transactions as csv
items.where: settings → tele → interface → lists → search and export star transactions

items.text: filter transactions, gifts and shared media by a date range
items.where: settings → tele → interface → lists → filter lists by date

items.text: save downloads into Telegram/<chat name> folders
turn off telegram's ai features, voice transcription stays
items.where: settings → tele → chats → turn off ai features

items.text: open locations in google maps, openstreetmap, yandex maps, 2gis or apple maps
items.where: settings → tele → messages → maps → map service

items.text: a thinner brush in the photo editor
items.where: settings → tele → interface → editor → thinner brush in the editor

items.text: based on telegram 13.1.1
hiding phone numbers also hides your own number in settings
items.where: settings → tele → privacy → hide phone numbers in profiles

the call log loads again after a failed page
